author: simulation_agent

inequalities.inequality: each record holds at least ten hops

precondition.requires: the run must report the hops per record it measured. The rate over a few-kT saddle in this landscape has no safe closed form, so A2 does not predict it: the record length is the bench's, and whether it holds ten hops is the run's first result

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the tracer in the bottle in use

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water; asked over 292-294 K and the entry's validity covers it. The bench's in-situ diffusivity, near the coverslip, replaces the Stokes drag in the re-prediction

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_1
numbers.note: 1 pN/um. Nothing in the store gives a trap stiffness; the experiment calibrates each trap after it is set. Chosen at the soft end, where the stiffness-matching tolerance is about five per cent at this width

numbers.name: record_length
numbers.note: ten minutes, the short end of the 10-60 min the experiment might record. Assumed; the spread over records at 10, 30 and 60 min is a separate study

numbers.name: walkers
numbers.note: independent single-bead records in one engine run, each as long as the bench record

numbers.name: drag_coefficient
numbers.note: bulk Stokes drag. Near the coverslip the drag is larger; the bench's in-situ diffusivity replaces this in the re-prediction

numbers.name: trap_relaxation_time
numbers.note: gamma/k at the bottom of one well alone: the shortest time in the problem. Near merging the curvature at the minima is smaller, so the true in-well time is longer and this bound is safe

numbers.name: startup_relaxation_times
numbers.note: the discard in units of gamma/k

numbers.name: startup_discard_min
numbers.note: the walkers start at the trap centres, half in each; two hundred in-well times relaxes each into its well. It does not relax the occupancy between wells, and for equal wells it need not

numbers.name: records_min
numbers.note: independent single-bead records, so the spread one record shows can be read, not guessed

numbers.name: hops_per_record_min
numbers.note: below this a record bounds the rate rather than measuring it (the observable's own note)

assumptions.statement: 1 pN/um for both traps: the soft end of what the tweezers hold a 5 um bead at, where the matching tolerance is about five per cent. Nothing measured picks it.
assumptions.falsifier: the experiment's calibrated stiffness of each trap, returned after the traps are set, replaces both and the simulation re-predicts at them

assumptions.statement: The records as the bench might take them, and the ensembles that stand for them: ten minutes at a 10 ms frame as the base, thirty minutes and a 50 ms frame at one point to show what the spread is sensitive to, a thousand independent records a point (five hundred for the long one, for storage), and a smoke run of a tenth.
assumptions.falsifier: the bench's actual record length and frame interval replace the first two, and the thousand-record spread study replaces the ensemble

assumptions.statement: Two hundred in-well relaxation times of discard.
assumptions.falsifier: an occupancy that still drifts between the first and second halves of the record

assumptions.statement: A hundred records is the least that shows a spread.
assumptions.falsifier: the thousand-record spread study replaces it

assumptions.statement: Ten hops a record separates a measured rate from a bound.
assumptions.falsifier: a record with fewer is reported as a bound and the plan's barrier is lowered

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.

note: The hop count is a precondition and not an interval, on purpose: an interval would need a predicted rate, and the configuration is declared because that rate is not predictable.
